app_name.description: The working name of the site, shown in the header and the browser tab.

meta_description.message: A place to ask for prayer and to pray for others.
meta_description.description: Short description for search engines and link previews. Never contains request text.

skip_to_requests.description: Hidden link for keyboard and screen-reader users that jumps past the header.

tabs_label.description: Screen-reader name for the two tabs that choose the ordering.

tab_need.description: Tab: requests with the fewest prayers first. The default view.

tab_new.description: Tab: most recently published requests first.

kind_self.description: Card label: the author asks for prayer for themselves.

kind_other.description: Card label: the author asks for prayer for another person.

kind_event.description: Card label: the request is for an event or a group of people.

prayed_none.description: Shown on a card nobody has prayed for yet.

prayed_one.description: Prayer count on a card, plural form 'one'. Languages may also define prayed_zero, prayed_two, prayed_few, prayed_many.

prayed_other.description: Prayer count on a card, general plural form. {n} is the number.

more.description: Link at the bottom of the wall that loads the next 20 requests.

empty.message: There are no requests here yet.
empty.description: Shown when the wall has nothing to show.

language.description: Heading of the language list in the footer.

source_code.description: Footer link to the source code of the running version.

ask_for_prayer.description: Button in the header that opens the posting form; also the title of that form.

my_request.description: Header link shown only on a device that has posted a request; opens the private page.

back_to_wall.description: Link from the form, confirmation and private pages back to the wall.

form_kind_self.description: Form choice: the request is for the author.

form_kind_other.description: Form choice: the request is for another person.

form_kind_event.description: Form choice: the request is for an event or a group.

form_name.description: Label of the optional first-name field.

form_name_help.message: First name only. If this is for someone else, leave out anything that identifies them.
form_name_help.description: Helper text under the first-name field.

form_body.description: Label of the request text field.

form_body_help.description: Helper text under the request field.

form_lang.description: Label of the list where the author says which language the request is written in.

form_lang_other.description: Last entry of the 'Written in' list.

form_country.description: Label of the optional country list. The author chooses; nothing is detected.

form_country_none.description: First entry of the country list; the default.

form_country_help.message: If you choose a country, it is shown beside your request.
form_country_help.description: Helper text under the country list.

form_rules.description: Heading above the three rules on the form.

rule_contact.description: First of the three short rules on the form.

rule_money.description: Second of the three short rules on the form.

rule_preach.description: Third of the three short rules on the form.

form_submit.description: The button that sends the request.

form_needs_js.message: Posting needs JavaScript for a quick check that you are a person. Reading the wall works without it.
form_needs_js.description: Shown on the form when JavaScript is off.

err_title.description: Heading of the message shown when a post is refused. The author's text is kept.

err_too_long.message: Your request is longer than 500 characters. Please shorten it.

err_link.message: Please remove the link or web address. The wall cannot carry links.

err_email.message: Please remove the email address. The wall cannot carry contact details.

err_phone.message: Please remove the phone number. The wall cannot carry contact details.

err_handle.message: Please remove the username. The wall cannot carry contact details.
err_handle.description: Refusal: contains a username such as @name.

err_name_long.message: Please keep the first name to 30 characters.
err_name_long.description: Refusal: the first name is too long.

err_name_contact.message: Please use a first name only, without contact details.
err_name_contact.description: Refusal: the first-name field contains contact details.

err_kind.message: Please choose who this request is for.
err_kind.description: Refusal: no choice made for 'Who is this for?'.

err_bot.message: We could not confirm that you are a person. Please try again.
err_bot.description: Refusal: the bot check did not pass.

err_too_many.message: Many requests have come from your network today, so we cannot take more until tomorrow. Your text is still here.
err_too_many.description: Refusal: more than 60 posts from one network in a day. Polite; the text is kept.

err_origin.message: This form was sent from somewhere else. Please open the page again and retry.
err_origin.description: Shown when a form post does not come from this site.

posting_closed.message: Posting is paused for now. You can still read the wall.
posting_closed.description: Kind notice shown instead of the form when posting is closed.

confirm_title.description: Heading of the confirmation page. Must not promise that people will pray or that it is on the wall.

confirm_link.description: Label of the field holding the author's private link.

confirm_keep.message: Keep this link. It is the only way to manage your request.
confirm_keep.description: The one sentence under the private link.

copy_link.description: Button that copies the private link.

copied.description: Shown on the copy button after it worked.

open_my_request.description: Link from the confirmation page to the private page.

mine_paste.description: Label of the field on the private page when no link was given.

mine_paste_help.message: This is the link you were shown after posting.

mine_open.description: Button that opens the request for the pasted link.

mine_not_found.message: We could not find a request for this link. It may have expired or been deleted.

mine_too_many.message: There were too many tries from your network. Please wait an hour and try again.

status_held.description: Private page status: a moderator has not decided yet.

status_published.message: Your request is on the wall, and people can pray for it.

status_removed.message: This request was removed by a moderator.

answered_done.message: You marked this request as answered.
answered_done.description: Private page: shown once the author has marked it answered.

extended_done.message: Your request will stay on the wall 30 more days.

act_extend.message: Keep it on the wall 30 more days

delete_title.description: Heading of the delete confirmation step.

delete_body.message: It will be removed at once and cannot be brought back.
delete_body.description: Text of the delete confirmation step.
